name: class array foreign object written through any alias keeps identity
source: class C { n = 1; bump(): number { this.n += 1; return this.n; } } function main(): void { const nat: C[] = []; const v: any = nat; const o: any = { n: 7 }; v[0] = o; console.log(nat[0] === o, nat[0] instanceof C, nat[0].n); }
